dance.songTitle: Let’s Face The Music And Dance
dance.line: And while we still have that chance
stanza: Before the fiddlers have fled
Before they ask us to pay the bill
And while we still have that chance
Let's face the music and dance

partner.line: Let's face the music and dance

dance.songTitle: One Of Those Days In England
dance.line: As I was crashed out, livin' every chance
stanza: One of those days in England that you said could never end
As I was crashed out, livin' every chance
One of those days in England we've been saving up to spend
Buying rides on Mother Nature's funny belly dance

partner.line: Buying rides on Mother Nature's funny belly dance

stanza: It's like a dime a dance
I'll take a chance
I will because he needs me
No one ever asked before
Before because they never needed me
But I do
But he does

partner.line: It's like a dime a dance
